intro: Portland's public sauna scene mixes riverside options with indoor sauna houses: a mobile wood-fired sauna on the Willamette, a floating sauna on the Columbia, and a wood-fired social sauna behind a SE Belmont bar. Indoor choices include two Finnish-style sauna houses and a rooftop pool-and-sauna bathhouse downtown. Most places sell timed sessions, so book ahead.

venues.name: Secret Sauna PDX
venues.schedule: Mixed social sessions plus quiet sessions; private 90-minute bookings for up to 12. Swimsuit or athletic wear required.
venues.notes: Behind Patufet bar; enter through the bar during its 4-9pm hours or the wooden gate on the west side. Bring two towels and slides (rentals available). Not wheelchair accessible.

venues.name: Guss
venues.neighborhood: Sellwood Riverfront Park or Willamette Park (varies by session)
venues.schedule: Mixed social sessions, ages 16+; check the location listed with each booking time.
venues.notes: Swimsuit and two towels required. No showers; changing is at nearby park restrooms, so arrive ready. 5-session punch pass $120. Runs rain or shine.

venues.name: Ebb & Ember Floating Saunas
venues.drop_in_price: $49 off-peak, $59 peak; $39 sunrise or moonlight session
venues.session_length: 1 hour 45 minutes (sunrise and moonlight sessions 1 hour)
venues.cold_plunge: Columbia River, plus bucket shower and cold deck shower
venues.schedule: Daily 6am-10pm. Shared, unstaffed social sessions for up to 8 guests.
venues.notes: Docked at Elevated Tides Marina. Peak is Friday 5pm through Sunday and holidays. Bathroom and shower on the deck lounge.

venues.name: Löyly Southeast
venues.notes: Visit includes sauna, showers, locker room and lounge; towel and robe provided. Monthly ritual days add guided Aufguss and whisking.

venues.name: Löyly Northeast
venues.address: 3525 NE Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, Portland, OR 97212
venues.notes: Same pricing and visit format as the Southeast location; towel and robe provided.

venues.name: Knot Springs (The Springs)
venues.cold_plunge: Plunge pool (47 degrees F per venue)
venues.notes: Visit covers warm and hot soaking pools, sauna, steam room, cold plunge and a deck with river and skyline views. Groups over 4 book by phone.
